summary_en: This phase I study tests CA-4948 (emavusertib) given together with FOLFOX (fluorouracil, leucovorin, oxaliplatin) plus bevacizumab as first treatment for metastatic colorectal cancer. CA-4948 is taken by mouth twice a day on days 1 to 14 of each 14-day cycle, and the other drugs are given through a vein, with treatment continuing for up to 2 years if the disease does not progress and side effects are not unacceptable. The record describes the study's aims as side effects and best dose, and no primary outcome measure is listed.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase I evalúa CA-4948 (emavusertib) administrado junto con FOLFOX (fluorouracilo, leucovorina, oxaliplatino) más bevacizumab como tratamiento inicial para el cáncer colorrectal metastásico. CA-4948 se toma por vía oral dos veces al día en los días 1 a 14 de cada ciclo de 14 días, y los demás medicamentos se administran por vena; el tratamiento puede continuar hasta 2 años si la enfermedad no progresa y los efectos secundarios no son inaceptables. El registro describe los objetivos del estudio como los efectos secundarios y la mejor dosis, y no se indica una medida de resultado principal.
who_for: Colorectal adenocarcinoma confirmed by tissue or cell testing.
Unresectable or metastatic disease that can be measured on imaging.
ECOG performance status 2 or better, or Karnofsky 60% or higher.
Adequate blood counts, liver and kidney tests, and heart function (NYHA class II or better if heart disease history).
not_for: Colorectal cancer that is MSI-H or dMMR.
Prior chemotherapy in any setting, or prior bevacizumab or similar antiangiogenic drugs.
QTcF interval above 450 ms on screening ECG.
Pregnant women, or women who are breastfeeding while treated.
